name: verify_engine
rationale: ext4 with execf=None and no entry masks must reproduce ext3 B-MV bit for bit at all 8 offsets (not a trial)

name: twap2
rationale: Split every weight change over 2 hours; averages entry price over the post-rebalance hours and dilutes 1h reversal noise at no extra turnover

name: twap3
rationale: same family 3h

name: twap4
rationale: same family 4h

name: delay1_all
rationale: Control: every change executed 1h late. Separates pure 'later entry' drift from signal-conditioned timing

name: SE_r1le0_H4
rationale: New short entries wait until the coin's last-1h BTC residual is <= 0 (pump has stopped rising); forced at 4h. Avoids shorting into continuing squeezes

name: SE_r2le0_H4
rationale: same family: last-2h cumulative residual <= 0

name: SE_r3le0_H6
rationale: same family: last-3h cumulative residual <= 0; forced at 6h

name: SX_dump_H4
rationale: Short covers (to 0 or reduction) are delayed while the name is dumping (last-3h resid < 0) until its 1h resid >= 0; forced at 4h. Prior diag_rev: bottom-5% 3h-residual names keep falling (-2.8 bp/h)
params: cond: start if r3<0; exec when r1>=0

name: SX_bigdump_H4
rationale: same as E08 but only when the 3h residual < -2 sigma_h*sqrt(3) (real dump); otherwise immediate
params: sigma_h = 168h hourly idio std at i0

name: LE_r1ge0_H4
rationale: New long entries wait until the last-1h residual is >= 0 (stops falling); forced at 4h. Same bottom-tail continuation evidence as E08

name: LX_pump_H4
rationale: Symmetric control: long exits delayed while pumping (r3>0) until r1<=0; forced at 4h. Prior says top tail underperforms so expected <= 0

name: downside_combo
rationale: E08+E10 (the two rules backed by bottom-tail continuation) combined

name: all4_combo
rationale: E05+E08+E10+E11 all symmetric rules combined

name: diag_phase
rationale: DIAGNOSTIC (not a trial): mean BTC-residual return per hour-of-day mod 8 (phase vs 00/08/16 UTC settlement) for top-quintile funding / bottom-quintile funding / B-MV short-candidate names inside M; NW t per phase; plus B-MV SR per clock offset

name: clock_by_mechanism
rationale: Pre-registered rule: IF F00 shows a phase block with |t|>=3 for high-funding names then choose the single offset whose entry/exit fill hour is the one the drift favours for the short leg (enter shorts before the predicted drop / after the predicted rise); judge its single-clock book vs the 8-clock-averaged B-MV and report its rank among the 8 clocks. IF no phase has |t|>=3 the trial is recorded as 'no mechanism' and no clock is chosen
params: F00 outcome: fund_top20% phase-6 t=-3.0 (fund_top20%_pos -3.2) -> rule triggers; drift favours having NEW shorts earn the phase-6 bar first => first earning bar phase 6 => offset 3 (reb when (hour+4)%8==0)

name: volspike5_both
rationale: Block NEW entries (both legs) if any hourly quote volume in the last 8h > 5x its trailing 168h hourly mean: volume spikes flag news/flows whose idio-vol read is stale

name: volspike5_short
rationale: same filter on short entries only (squeeze risk after flow spikes)

name: volspike5_long
rationale: same filter on long entries only (calm-name long is no longer calm)

name: volspike3_both
rationale: family member

name: volspike10_both
rationale: family member

name: jump4_both
rationale: Block NEW entries if any hourly |BTC-residual| in the last 8h > 4 sigma_h (168h hourly idio std at i)

name: jump4_short
rationale: jump filter on short entries only

name: jump4_long
rationale: jump filter on long entries only

name: jump3_both
rationale: family member

name: jump6_both
rationale: family member

name: gaprev4_both
rationale: Block NEW entries if a >4 sigma_h hourly residual jump in the last 8h was followed by a retrace of >50% of it (opposite-sign cumulative residual since the jump): unstable price discovery

name: clock_phase0_posthoc
rationale: POST-HOC (registered after F00 and after the B-MV per-clock table was printed): F00's strongest effect is the S0 long-short spread in the phase-0 bar (long cands +2.4 bp t5.2, short cands -1.9 bp t-3.8); freshest portfolio should earn phase 0 first => offset 1

name: peer_mom72
rationale: Lagged cross-predictability: mean 72h residual return of the coin's 10 most-correlated peers (336h residual corr, M only). Slow information diffusion across related coins (Cohen-Frazzini style); never tested (only BTC lead-lag was) || Screen rule (pre-registered): cross-sectional rank IC inside M of pct(feature) residualised on pct(S0) vs forward residual return R[i+2..i+9] (8h) and R[i+2..i+73] (72h) at offset-0 rebalance rows; sign fixed on 2020-03..2022-12; PROMOTE to a book trial only if 2023-2025 IC has the same sign with NW |t|>=2 at the 72h horizon. Promoted book trial: score=(1-w)*S0+w*pct(signed feat), w=0.15, B-MV 8-clock, same adoption bar. Max 3 promotions.

name: flow72
rationale: Volume-signed residual flow: sum over 72h of resid*Q/meanQ168. Separates informed volume-backed moves from thin drifts; plain momentum and volume shocks were tested separately, not their product || Screen rule (pre-registered): cross-sectional rank IC inside M of pct(feature) residualised on pct(S0) vs forward residual return R[i+2..i+9] (8h) and R[i+2..i+73] (72h) at offset-0 rebalance rows; sign fixed on 2020-03..2022-12; PROMOTE to a book trial only if 2023-2025 IC has the same sign with NW |t|>=2 at the 72h horizon. Promoted book trial: score=(1-w)*S0+w*pct(signed feat), w=0.15, B-MV 8-clock, same adoption bar. Max 3 promotions.

name: idio_share
rationale: Idiosyncratic share 1-R^2 of the 336h BTC regression. Distinct from idio vol level: a coin can be high-vol but BTC-driven || Screen rule (pre-registered): cross-sectional rank IC inside M of pct(feature) residualised on pct(S0) vs forward residual return R[i+2..i+9] (8h) and R[i+2..i+73] (72h) at offset-0 rebalance rows; sign fixed on 2020-03..2022-12; PROMOTE to a book trial only if 2023-2025 IC has the same sign with NW |t|>=2 at the 72h horizon. name: vol_hhi24
rationale: Hourly volume concentration: Herfindahl of hourly quote volume within 24h, averaged over 7d. Bursty volume = pump/dump flow signature || Screen rule (pre-registered): cross-sectional rank IC inside M of pct(feature) residualised on pct(S0) vs forward residual return R[i+2..i+9] (8h) and R[i+2..i+73] (72h) at offset-0 rebalance rows; sign fixed on 2020-03..2022-12; PROMOTE to a book trial only if 2023-2025 IC has the same sign with NW |t|>=2 at the 72h horizon. rationale: Variance ratio var(24h resid sums)/(24*var(1h resid)) over 336h: multi-hour trendiness vs mean reversion (phi only captured lag-1) || Screen rule (pre-registered): cross-sectional rank IC inside M of pct(feature) residualised on pct(S0) vs forward residual return R[i+2..i+9] (8h) and R[i+2..i+73] (72h) at offset-0 rebalance rows; sign fixed on 2020-03..2022-12; PROMOTE to a book trial only if 2023-2025 IC has the same sign with NW |t|>=2 at the 72h horizon. rationale: Coin-specific settlement pressure: mean residual in phase-0 bars (00/08/16) minus other bars over the last 30d; follows up F00's phase-0 effect at coin level || Screen rule (pre-registered): cross-sectional rank IC inside M of pct(feature) residualised on pct(S0) vs forward residual return R[i+2..i+9] (8h) and R[i+2..i+73] (72h) at offset-0 rebalance rows; sign fixed on 2020-03..2022-12; PROMOTE to a book trial only if 2023-2025 IC has the same sign with NW |t|>=2 at the 72h horizon. name: flow72_blend15
rationale: PROMOTED by screen (IS IC72 -0.033 t-2.8; OOS -0.043 t-6.7): high volume-signed 72h residual flow -> underperform. score=0.85*S0+0.15*pct(flow72 in M) (high flow -> short side)

name: idioshare_blend15
rationale: PROMOTED by screen (IS IC72 -0.042 t-3.0; OOS -0.027 t-3.7): high idiosyncratic share -> underperform beyond idio-vol level. score=0.85*S0+0.15*pct(1-R2 in M)

name: flow72_sleeve
rationale: Pre-registered after N02b failed: the IC may live outside S0's tails, so run flow72 as its own market-neutral sleeve: ext4.book(pct(flow72) within M; N=NS=20; short_frac 0.5; stop 0.2; minvar_floor off; 8h; 8-clock avg), scale to B-MV vol, blend (1-rw)*B-MV + rw*sleeve with rw=0.25 (0.15/0.35 shown as sensitivity only). Gate: decile diagnostic must show the top decile of S0-neutral flow72 underperforms (else trial recorded as not run)
